title: Correct capacitance value
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly compute the capacitance using C = Q/U, obtaining approximately 1.67 × 10⁻⁹ F.

title: Correct electric field strength
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly compute the electric field strength using E = U/d, obtaining 900 V/m.

title: Correct potential at C
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly compute the electric potential at point C, obtaining -27 V.

title: Circuit analysis for voltage
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply Ohm's law to find the current in the loop and the voltage across R₂ (and thus the capacitor).

title: Potential difference calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly relate the potential at C to the potential at A using the electric field and distance d_AC.

title: Sign error in potential
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student incorrectly assigns the sign of the potential at point C (e.g., giving +27 V instead of -27 V).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student correctly converts all distances to meters and maintains consistent SI units throughout.
